name: Texas
source: Texas levies no personal income tax (confirmed primary, read 2026-10-24): Texas Constitution, Article 8, Section 24-a, added by H.J.R. 38 (86th Legislature) and adopted at the election of 2019-11-05, says the legislature may not impose a tax on the net incomes of individuals, including an individual's share of partnership and unincorporated association income (enrolled text https://capitol.texas.gov/tlodocs/86R/billtext/html/HJ00038F.htm; codified at https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/CN/htm/CN.8.htm); the Comptroller's list of state taxes (https://comptroller.texas.gov/taxes/) names no personal income tax; second source Tax Foundation, State Individual Income Tax Rates and Brackets 2026 (https://taxfoundation.org/data/all/state/state-income-tax-rates-2026/)

filing_tables.note: Every filing status uses the one zero-rate table: Texas has no personal income tax (Texas Constitution Art. 8, Sec. 24-a, enrolled H.J.R. 38 read 2026-10-24; Comptroller tax list read 2026-10-24).

state_base.note: Texas has no state income tax, so there is no state base and nothing to add back; 401(k), 403(b) and HSA deposits do not matter here. Confirmed primary: Texas Constitution Art. 8, Sec. 24-a (enrolled H.J.R. 38, 86th Legislature) and the Comptroller's tax list (https://comptroller.texas.gov/taxes/), both read 2026-10-24.

income_brackets.note: Zero-rate table (legislated, not indexed): Texas Constitution Art. 8, Sec. 24-a (enrolled H.J.R. 38, 86th Legislature) bars a tax on the net incomes of individuals, and the Comptroller's tax list names none (read 2026-10-24); it holds for 2026 and every later year until the constitution is amended.

estate_inheritance.check_at: https://comptroller.texas.gov/taxes/ (Texas inheritance tax ended for deaths after 2004)
estate_inheritance.note: Texas levies no estate tax and no inheritance tax: its inheritance tax was a pick-up of the federal state death tax credit and ended with that credit for deaths after 2004 (state-costs.csv columns estate_tax and inheritance_tax; Tax Foundation and Kiplinger state death-tax lists). Triage 2026-10-23 (category A): Texas has no estate or inheritance tax.

social_security.note: Texas has no personal income tax, so Social Security benefits are not taxed (Texas Constitution Art. 8, Sec. 24-a, enrolled H.J.R. 38 read 2026-10-24; Comptroller tax list https://comptroller.texas.gov/taxes/ read 2026-10-24).

local_income_tax.check_at: https://capitol.texas.gov/tlodocs/86R/billtext/html/HJ00038F.htm and Tax Foundation, Local Income Taxes in 2023 (https://taxfoundation.org/research/all/state/local-income-taxes-2023/)
local_income_tax.note: Texas counties and cities levy no income tax: Texas is not among the states with local income taxes in Tax Foundation, Local Income Taxes in 2023 (read in a search extract 2026-10-24), and Art. 8, Sec. 24-a bars a state tax on individuals' net incomes. No statute or agency page saying localities may not levy one was read, so it stays confirmed secondary. Triage 2026-10-23 (category A): Texas has no local income tax.

sales_tax.check_at: Texas revenue department sales and use tax rate tables
sales_tax.source: Tax Foundation, State and Local Sales Tax Rates, Midyear 2026 (https://taxfoundation.org/data/all/state/2026-sales-tax-rates-midyear/), as of 2026-07-01; groceries and clothing: https://zamp.com/resources/sales-tax-on-groceries and https://zamp.com/blog/sales-tax-on-clothing
sales_tax.note: Rates as fractions; avg_local_rate is the combined less the state rate, at least 0. vehicle_rate is the purchase tax on a car: 0.0625 from the state's own source (Texas motor vehicle sales tax 6.25% of the price less trade-in (https://comptroller.texas.gov/taxes/motor-vehicle/sales-use.php, validation run 2)). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py. Groceries and clothing: grocery_rate is the state rate on groceries (0.0) plus the average local rate where locals tax them (locals: no); research note: Food products exempt from state and local. clothing_taxable is true (research: yes; taxed). Set by hand from .claude/state/research/grocery-tax.csv and clothing-tax.csv (s329).

property_tax.check_at: Census ACS 2024 1-year tables B25090 and B25082 at https://data.census.gov
property_tax.source: Census ACS 2024 1-year (B25090 / B25082) as compiled at https://floridaprobateandfamilylaw.com/blog/effective-property-tax-rates-by-state-2025/
property_tax.note: Effective rate: real-estate taxes paid divided by home value, owner-occupied homes. Senior relief, homestead caps and freezes are not in it (a buyer pays the full rate). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

home_insurance.source: Insurify state table for a 300,000 dwelling (https://insurify.com/homeowners-insurance/states/), October 2026
home_insurance.note: Average annual premium for a 300,000 dwelling. Quote averages differ by 20 to 40 percent between publishers, so the model uses it as a ratio between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_insurance.source: Insurify full coverage, monthly times 12 (https://insurify.com/car-insurance/states/), October 2026
car_insurance.note: Average annual full-coverage premium. Used as a ratio between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_taxes.check_at: TxDMV registration fee chart (https://www.txdmv.gov) and Texas Transportation Code 502
car_taxes.source: carregistrationfee.com Texas guide and dmvfeecalculator.com, 2026 (base 50.75, inspection program replacement 7.50, TexasSure included in the base, processing 4.75, county 0 to 21.50, most 11.50)
car_taxes.note: Texas: base registration 50.75 plus state add-ons of about 13 and a county fee of 0 to 31.50 (about 11.50; base 50.75 includes TexasSure, https://www.txdmv.gov/motorists/register-your-vehicle, validation run 2, 2026-10-22); about 75 a year. No annual vehicle property tax (the 6.25% motor vehicle sales tax is paid once at purchase). Typical car, averaged over about ten years of ownership; registration and vehicle taxes only (no title, plate or inspection fees). Set by hand after the import: rerunning importStateCosts.py resets it to 0.

fuel.note: gas_tax_per_gallon is the state excise in dollars, without sales tax on fuel: 0.2 (20 cents/gal (Tax Code 162.102)); average_price_per_gallon is the 2024 average pump price (grade unclear, about regular). Price: 2.862, EIA Texas regular retail, 2024 annual (2025: 2.660) (validation run 3, 2026-10-22). Set by hand from the primary source in validation run 2, 2026-10-22; importStateCosts.py keeps a hand-set section.

utilities.source: EIA Electric Power Monthly Table 5.6.B, residential price, January to July 2026
utilities.note: Average residential electricity price in dollars per kWh, January to July 2026 (a partial year). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

housing.check_at: https://fred.stlouisfed.org (Zillow Home Value Index by state) and https://meric.mo.gov/data/cost-living-data-series
housing.source: Zillow Home Value Index by state via FRED (September 2026); MERIC Cost of Living Data Series housing index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026
housing.note: typical_home_value is the Zillow Home Value Index (all homes, middle tier); cost_index is the MERIC housing cost index (US = 100), used to scale rent after a move. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

health_premiums.check_at: https://www.kff.org/affordable-care-act/state-indicator/average-marketplace-premiums-by-metal-tier/, Texas insurance department Medigap rate guide and the CMS MA Landscape and Part D files (https://www.cms.gov)
health_premiums.source: KFF Average Marketplace Premiums by Metal Tier 2026 (benchmark silver at 40, times the federal age curve 2.124 for 60); MoneyGeek Medicare Supplement Plan G at 65, 2026; KFF Average Monthly Premium for PDPs, 2024; MedicareSupplement.com analysis of the CMS 2026 MA Landscape files
health_premiums.note: Monthly premiums per person, unsubsidized list prices: aca_60_monthly is the benchmark silver plan at 60 (estimated from the age-40 figure), medigap_g_monthly Plan G at 65, part_d_monthly the enrollment-weighted Part D plan, medicare_advantage_monthly the average Medicare Advantage premium. Null means no usable figure; a move then leaves that premium unchanged. Used as ratios between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

price_indexes.source: MERIC Cost of Living Data Series grocery index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026; BEA Regional Price Parities by state, goods and other services (US = 100), 2024, release of 2026-02-19 via FRED
price_indexes.note: Price levels with US = 100: grocery_index is the MERIC grocery index, bea_goods and bea_services the BEA Regional Price Parities for goods and for services other than rent. Used as ratios between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

long_term_care.source: Genworth / CareScout Cost of Care Survey 2024, Ranked State Data Tables, state medians (https://assets.carescout.com/a41bb6478c/298701.pdf)
long_term_care.note: State median monthly costs: a home health aide, an assisted living facility and a private nursing home room. Stored for reference; the model does not use them. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.
